p: Jesus Christ came of Abraham of the tribe of Judah, and of the family of David as God promised.
book of the: Rehearsal: as the Hebrews used to speak; see Ge 5:1, the book of the generations.
generation of Jesus Christ: Of the ancestors from whom Christ came.
son of Abraham: Christ is also the son of Abraham.
Jechonias and his brethren: That is, the captivity fell in the days of Jakim and Jechonias: for Jechonias was born before the carrying away into captivity.
the generations: All those who were considered to be in the lineage of David's family, as they begat one another orderly in turn.
Christ is the true Emmanuel, and therefore, Jesus (that is, Saviour) is conceived in the virgin by the Holy Spirit, as foretold by the prophets.
take to thee Mary: Receive her from her parents and kinsfolks hands.
wife: Who was promised, and made sure to you to be your wife.
begotten in her is of the: Of the mother's substance by the Holy Spirit.
Christ is born of the same virgin who never knew a man: and is named Jesus by God himself through the angel.
his people from their sins: Save, and this shows us the meaning of the name Jesus.
virgin shall be with child: There is an article added in the Hebrew and Greek text, to point out the woman and set her forth plainly: as we would say, the virgin, or a certain virgin.

till she had brought forth her: The word "till", in the Hebrew language, gives us to understand that a thing will not come to pass in time to come: as Michal had no children "till" her death day, 2Sa 6:23. And in the last chapter of this evangelist: Behold, I am with you "till" the end of the world.
